bandit.detail: 0 issues after fixes (initial: 1 high B324, 3 low)

semgrep.detail: 81 files; 8 findings: 6 fixed, 2 false positives (F-16); Dockerfile parser unsupported

pip-audit.detail: no known vulnerabilities in the installed environment

osv-scanner.detail: requirements.txt, requirements-dev.txt, tools/firebase lockfile: clean after F-13/F-14

hypothesis.detail: 22 properties; found F-04 and the '..' filename case

findings.title: A .docx zip bomb (a few KB inflating to GBs) was parsed without limits
findings.remediation: document_loader.docx_is_safe checks entry count, per-part and total size and ratio from the zip directory before any parsing

findings.title: JSON request bodies were buffered in full before the size cap was applied (chunked transfer, no Content-Length)
findings.remediation: main._json_body streams the body and stops at MAX_JSON_BYTES

findings.title: Parallel uploads could exceed the per-user / guest document cap (check-then-act race)
findings.remediation: the cap check, the save and the registration run under one per-session lock; mutation-tested (7 stored with the lock removed, cap 5)

findings.title: Streaming parsers crashed on well-formed JSON events that are not objects (null, array, number)
A corrupt value in Redis raised through the state store and tripped the 30 s circuit breaker for everything
findings.remediation: RedisStore drops undecodable values/fields and reports them as absent; the breaker is for outages only

findings.title: Application shutdown raised if Redis was down
findings.remediation: ResilientStore.close swallows and logs the error

findings.title: Every token with an unknown key id made the server fetch Google's certificates (outbound amplification)
findings.remediation: refetch at most once per 60 s

findings.title: Filenames could carry bidirectional-override / zero-width characters, backslash paths or a bare '..'
Prompt-structure forgery: fence variants (case, spacing, full-width), fake '[Page N]' labels and bracket-closing filenames
findings.remediation: llm_client._neutralize defuses any run of 3+ angle brackets and [Page N] lookalikes in document text, history and filenames

findings.title: A saved HNSW index was deserialised by FAISS with only a digest stored next to it
findings.remediation: index blobs are stored only with DOCULENS_STATE_KEY and verified with HMAC-SHA256; otherwise rebuilt from the embeddings

findings.title: A document removed on another instance between the membership check and the load raised IndexError (500)
GitHub Actions referenced by mutable tags; checkout persisted credentials (zizmor: 4 high, 2 low)
findings.remediation: every action pinned to a full commit SHA, persist-credentials: false, minimal permissions

findings.title: Dependency floors allowed versions with published advisories (pyjwt, anyio, idna, torch, transformers, pygments)
findings.remediation: requirements minimums raised; pip-audit and OSV re-run clean

findings.title: firebase meta-package pulled firestore/grpc (4 high npm advisories) although only auth is bundled
findings.remediation: tools/firebase now depends on @firebase/app and @firebase/auth only; npm audit: 0

findings.title: SHA-1 used for an in-memory cache key (bandit B324 high); silent except-pass in pdf_loader (B110/B112)
Semgrep ssrf-injection-requests on llm_client._post (variable named 'request')
findings.remediation: the URL is built from operator configuration only; renamed and a host-equality check added as defence in depth

findings.title: CSP must allow https://apis.google.com for Firebase's popup sign-in
findings.remediation: applies only when Firebase is configured; every DOM sink is textContent (tested), no inline script/eval, object-src and base-uri none

acceptance.rationale: applies only when Firebase is configured; every DOM sink is textContent (tested), no inline script/eval, object-src and base-uri none

findings.title: A stolen Firebase ID token can be exchanged for a login for up to an hour (no jti to revoke)
findings.remediation: inherent to bearer tokens; /api/login is rate limited, our own session is separately revocable (logout)

acceptance.rationale: inherent to bearer tokens; /api/login is rate limited, our own session is separately revocable (logout)

findings.title: A PDF 'flate bomb' can exhaust memory inside PyMuPDF text extraction, which cannot be bounded in-process
findings.remediation: container memory limit and restart policy (deploy command, container-security.yml); page and time limits; recommended: run behind --memory

acceptance.rationale: container memory limit and restart policy (deploy command, container-security.yml); page and time limits; recommended: run behind --memory

secrets.note: no secret in git history or tracked files; the local .env is untracked and gitignored
